pages.title: Critical Alerts
pages.text: When any nutrient bar drops below $(bold)25%$(), a toast notification fires in the corner of your screen — telling you exactly which group needs attention.$(br2)$(c:#e05252)By the time it fires, the debuff is already active or seconds away.$()$(br2)The best strategy is to never need the warning.

pages.title: Staying Ahead
pages.text: Watch your $(thing)HUD$() and top up bars that are trending downward $(bold)before$() they hit 25%.$(br2)If you miss a toast and a debuff appears — open the $(thing)Diet Screen$() immediately. The most neglected groups are listed right at the top.$(br2)$(italic)A downward trend arrow is a warning. A toast is a crisis. Aim for warnings.$()
